value.rationale: The finite full transformation monoid is canonical, and splitting of its symmetric conjugacy types under the alternating subgroup is a natural representation-theoretic orbit question. The result gives a complete constructive splitting test and an exact, cancellation-free all-degree enumerator, refining the classical symmetric total. The three nested parity obstructions and primitive-necklace correction are needed for this invariant, not arbitrary parameter slicing.
